class: Several branches or builder changes that each pass their own tests can fail together once merged (duplicated constants, a scan broken by another file's comment, a second computation of a shared figure); a hand-picked test list after a merge batch misses this, and only the full check's first gate on the combined head sees it.
mechanism: Each builder ran targeted tests green. After the merge batch the structure tests found two real duplicated constants and one apostrophe in a comment that made a scan give up on its file, failing three tests, and a performance regression appeared that no single diff showed.

first_seen.where: GC-ICFIX third and fourth priority groups, merged branch before b3b2911a
first_seen.evidence: the full local check failed twice on the combined head (seven structure tests, then a performance test) while every branch had passed alone; run 13 passed on b3b2911a with TOTAL PASS 2138.6s

fix: After every merge batch run the full check's own first gate on the combined head, never a hand-picked list; merge the next batch only when it is green.

detection.note: A rule in the runbook step, not yet a mechanism; the full local check catches it only when it is run after each batch.
